purpose: Separate a completed classical errors-in-variables sensitivity envelope from an empirical estimate of predictor reliability.

southwest_pacific_ciarle_2025_animal.predictor: FM: mainland relative flower size mean in mm
southwest_pacific_ciarle_2025_animal.reason: S2 supplies pair-level FI/FM means and source trait ranges but no replicate-level mainland measurements, sampling variance, repeat-measurement identifiers, or independently calibrated measurement error from which reliability of log(FM) can be estimated.
admissible_next_evidence: source-level raw replicate flower measurements with stable taxon/population identifiers
published n plus within-source SD/SE tied to the exact FM estimate
independent validation or repeatability study applicable to the exact measurement process

new_zealand_hendriks_2019.reason: The reconstructed appendix supplies pair-level mainland flower-area values but not replicate-level measurement error information that identifies reliability of the predictor.
admissible_next_evidence: checksum-locked source bytes plus source-linked raw replicate measurements
published sampling variance or repeatability tied to the exact flower-area estimates
independent measurement validation applicable to the source protocol

claim_boundary: The EIV sensitivity analysis is complete as an assumption envelope. The current source-native materials do not identify empirical predictor reliability, so the threshold cannot be treated as observed support for correction or formal admission. Trait min/max ranges are not reinterpreted as repeatability estimates.
